evidence_boundary.allowed_claim: Under the same frozen full320 bank and exact probe protocol, mixed-environment coverage has different held-out purpose-decoding effects in Llama-3.1 8B and 70B.
limitations: The 8B prior layer-12 development result was known before freeze.
The 70B comparator result was known before freeze.
The interaction is a confirmation of a directional size-associated hypothesis, not a blinded discovery.
Model size remains confounded with checkpoint-specific training dynamics even within Llama-3.1.
The item bank is fixed and stored environments confound format with template populations.
The endpoint is observational probe decoding, not behavior.
